## Answer: No. Sarah Chen cannot approve DR-9109, and the contract does not support it.

DR-9109 matches Northstar CRM exactly: CRM-2048, NS-EDGE, 12.0%, $85,000 list, $10,200 discount, $74,800 net, dated 2026-09-23, Pending Approval.

**1. The contract basis does not cover this product.**
- The request cites "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
- The MSA (ACME-MFG-2025, in force 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31) does list NS-EDGE as a product Northstar supplies.
- However, its only discount term (§3.2) gives up to 15% on the **NS-500 only**, through Schedule B.
- Schedule B (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) says it applies "only to the product identified above… It does not apply to any other Northstar product."
- No exception covers NS-EDGE, and exceptions are scoped to the product they name (SOP-SALES-014).
- The 2025 "15% last September" precedent (DR-8104) was also NS-500.
- So the contract-pricing justification has no basis for NS-EDGE. It needs commercial review.

**2. The discount is above Sarah's authority anyway.**
- Pricing Policy 2026 applies to a request dated 2026-09-23.
- Under that policy, Enterprise Account Executives may approve up to 10%.
- A discount above 10% and up to 20% needs the Commercial Policy Lead, who is Dana Okafor.
- The 2025 policy's 15% limit for Account Executives no longer applies.
- MSA §3.3 confirms that contract eligibility does not change internal approval authority.

**What happens next:**
- Commercial review should decide whether Acme gets NS-EDGE pricing terms (an amendment or new exception), or whether this is a standard discount.
- If it is resubmitted as a standard 12% discount, Dana Okafor must approve it and record the approval in CRM.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9109", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-EDGE (NS-Edge Monitoring Package)", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered", "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and Schedule B EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant up to 15% on NS-500 only; no pricing exception covers NS-EDGE"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": null},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9109)", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "structured/employees.csv", "documents/organization_chart.md"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review to decide whether Acme receives NS-EDGE pricing terms (new or amended exception) or whether the request is resubmitted as a standard discount with the contract-pricing justification corrected", "who": "Deal Desk / Commercial Policy Lead (Dana Okafor)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Any discount above 10% on this request, standard or under new terms, requires Commercial Policy Lead approval (Dana Okafor) recorded in Northstar CRM; Sarah Chen's limit is 10% under Pricing Policy 2026", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": true}
  ]
}
```
